final: WITH channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS mean_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), overall_rate AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS mean_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(c.mean_rate) AS mean_average_fee_rate, AVG(c.mean_rate - g.mean_rate) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN overall_rate AS g WHERE c.mean_rate > g.mean_rate
